changed.title: Exact field-linear scan dimension for counting distinct affine-code words that satisfy local truth tables
changed.statement:
∀ (F : Type) [Field F] (k m t d : ℕ),
  let W := Fin k → ZMod 2
  ∀ (base : W) (gen : Fin m → W) (scope : Fin t → Finset (Fin k)),
    (∀ v : Fin k, ∃ j : Fin t, v ∈ scope j) →
    let key := fun a : Fin m → ZMod 2 => base + ∑ h : Fin m, a h • gen h
    let rk := fun S : Finset (Fin k) =>
      let M : Matrix (Fin m) S (ZMod 2) := fun row coord => gen row coord.val
      M.rank
    let need := (Finset.range (t+1)).sup (fun i =>
      let P := Finset.univ.filter (fun seen : Fin k => ∃ before : Fin t, before.val < i ∧ seen ∈ scope before)
      let Q := Finset.univ.filter (fun future : Fin k => ∃ after : Fin t, i ≤ after.val ∧ future ∈ scope after)
      2^(rk P + rk Q - rk Finset.univ))
    let T := fun idx : Fin t => (↥(scope idx) → ZMod 2) → Bool
    let count := fun tests : (j : Fin t) → T j =>
      Nat.card {w : W // w ∈ Set.range key ∧ ∀ j, tests j (fun tested => w tested.val) = true}
    (∃ (s : Fin d → F)
       (step : (j : Fin t) → T j → ((Fin d → F) →ₗ[F] (Fin d → F)))
       (out : (Fin d → F) →ₗ[F] F),
      ∀ tests : (j : Fin t) → T j,
        out ((List.finRange t).foldl (fun cur stage => step stage (tests stage) cur) s) =
          (count tests : F)) ↔ need ≤ d
changed.unlocks: Determines the exact linear memory for counting local tests restricted to a key code, including cuts with disjoint but correlated coordinate sets.
changed.context: Group legal prefixes by their sets of compatible suffixes. Each nonempty set is a coset of the future-only subcode. Equal or disjoint cosets give 2^(r(P)+r(Q)-r(all)) classes. Choose one word per class and pin its past and future projections by local singleton tables. The count matrix on these choices is an identity over every field and factors through the scan state. Conversely extend each class by feasible new coordinates, filter by the current table and add its prefix counts to the next classes. Initialize and finish with one class.

changed.title: A lower bound weighted by listed NOT gates for four-cycle-free sparse matrix selectors
changed.statement:
∀ (n m d : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (edge : Bool)
    (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  let nbrR := fun (a : Fin n) => Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin m => G a v = edge)
  let nbrC := fun (c : Fin m) => Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => G u c = edge)
  2 ≤ d →
  (∀ a, 2 ≤ (nbrR a).card ∧ (nbrR a).card ≤ d) →
  (∀ c, 2 ≤ (nbrC c).card ∧ (nbrC c).card ≤ d) →
  (∀ a b, a ≠ b → ((nbrR a) ∩ (nbrR b)).card ≤ 1) →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C → PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C →
  let negs := C.gates.countP (fun g => @decide (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) (Classical.propDecidable _))
  (28 * d + 1) * (n + m) + 12 * d * negs ≤ 28 * d * C.size + 78 * d + 2
changed.unlocks: bounds the size of a sparse matrix selector while charging all listed negations
changed.context: Fold constants and prune to a live binary cone while tracking retained NOTs. All but one input per bank must be read because neighborhoods distinguish vertices. A pure region has at most 4d private vertices and a one-entry region at most 6d. Sum the partition inequalities, writing K=D+H+P for total shared uses. Positive sharing or negations give e>=1. Handle the single pure tree directly. Each restored binary gate increases the budget by 28d and each restored NOT by 16d.

changed.title: A row guard history on a shortened seed permits q additional column pivots for every successful prefix
changed.statement:
∀ (k r q ell : Nat), 0 < q → q+2 ≤ r → 7*r+q ≤ k → k-(k+1)/2+q ≤ 6*r →
  5 ≤ ell → ell ≤ r → 5*ell+q ≤ 5*r+2 →
  let h := (k+1)/2
  let z := k-h
  let u := 5*r-3
  let tries := ell-1
  let rot := fun (offset x : Nat) =>
    ((x <<< (offset%k)) ||| (x >>> (k-offset%k))) % 2^k
  let mix := fun (gap value : Nat) => value ^^^ rot gap value ^^^ rot (k-gap) value
  let chi := fun (word : Nat) => (List.range k).foldl (fun acc site =>
    acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit site)
      (!(word.testBit ((site+1)%k)) && word.testBit ((site+2)%k))).toNat <<< site)) 0
  let step := fun (constants : Nat → Fin (2^k)) (col : Bool) (raw prev t : Nat) =>
    chi (mix (if col then 2 else 1) prev) ^^^ rot (if col then 3*t+1 else 2*(t-1)) raw ^^^
      (constants (if col then r+t else t)).val
  let state := fun (c : Nat → Fin (2^k)) (side : Bool) (key name : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun v tick => step c side key v (tick+1))
      (rot (if side then 3 else 1) key ^^^ name)
  let start := k-(2*r-2)
  let a := min h (k-u)
  let g := z-u
  let project := fun (wordAt : Nat) => rot (k-(start%k)) wordAt % 2^(u-q)
  let weight := fun (code : Nat) => ((List.range tries).filter (fun jj => code.testBit jj)).length
  ∀ (sched : Nat → Fin (2^k)) (row col : Fin (2^k)),
    let history := fun (label : Nat) =>
      let ref := rot start label
      let init : Nat × Nat × Nat := (rot 1 ref ^^^ row.val, 0, 0)
      let final := (List.range ell).foldl (fun triple idx =>
        let time := idx+1
        let place := k-q+3*(r-time)+min (q-1) triple.2.2
        let bit := (mix 1 triple.1).testBit ((place+1)%k)
        let next := step sched false ref triple.1 time
        if time=4 then (next, triple.2.1, triple.2.2)
        else (next, 2*triple.2.1+bit.toNat, triple.2.2+bit.toNat)) init
      final.2.1
    (∀ hist : Fin (2^tries),
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2^(u-q)))).filter
        (fun tag => history tag.val = hist.val)).card = 2^(u-q-tries)) ∧
    (∀ (seedTag : Fin (2^(u-q))) (rowBits : Fin (2^a)) (colBits : Fin (2^(q+g))),
      q ≤ weight (history seedTag.val) →
      ∃! w : Fin (2^k), project w.val = seedTag.val ∧
        (state sched false w.val row.val >>> (k-a)) = rowBits.val ∧
        (state sched true w.val col.val >>> (6*r-q)) % 2^(q+g) = colBits.val)
changed.unlocks: determines the reference multiplicity and unique completions of the row-seed guard histories
changed.context: Read the old mixed bit one site above the moving row boundary. The raw pivots are j−t at t=1,2,3 and j−2t+4 at t≥5. Skip t=4 where the previous state loses its left pivot. A successful reference freezes all selected row outputs while its top q seed sites vary. Complete rows with temporary zeros. The remaining gap and the q postponed bits are contiguous, so the last column injections solve them downwards. The column right endpoint cannot wrap back into a lower unsolved site. Estimate 3 to 4 hours.
